frictionOtherLines: plan exploration: background Explore agents failed repeatedly (API errors/stalls); fell back to direct reads by the main agent

structural: every deferral in this plan pointed at 10.3, but nothing checked that 10.3's task file actually listed what was being deferred to it — the debt lived in _progress.md, which the workflow deletes. A deferral needs a destination that survives the workflow

10_02 was the one task where the reviewer had to do forensics (recovering the owner's pre-edit README from a dangling blob) to confirm scope discipline — worth having a cheaper way to prove "verify, don't rewrite" was honoured
an audit task that claims completeness and misses half a requirement is worse than no audit — the asserting comment would have stopped the next reader from checking
over-deferral, third occurrence: 09_03 deferred two things to 10.3 that the generated service worker and the auth middleware already answered

infrastructure: agent worktrees live inside the repo at .claude/worktrees/, and eslint.config.mjs did not ignore .claude — `yarn lint` walked two extra full checkouts and died with a V8 OOM instead of a lint error. Fixed on this branch, but worth knowing generally

deferral judgement: implementers have twice deferred to 10.3 things that needed no browser at all (07_01 contrast, 09_01 hero size) — "I couldn't see it" is being conflated with "it can't be determined"
requirements gap: REQ-SRCH says nothing about multi-word query semantics — a core behavior for a search-first product
